result.title: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
result.comment: Submitted to DATE 2027. 7 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
result.summary: The growing complexity of electronic systems demands efficient design flows, yet EDA scripting remains a bottleneck: proprietary APIs are sparsely documented, and errors often appear as silent failures or cryptic exceptions. Hand-crafted knowledge helps but is difficult to maintain as toolchains evolve. We present ZhuLong-SE (Self-Evolution), an execution-grounded LLM agent that learns reusable knowledge from prior task traces. Building on ZhuLong, it enhances the task-level harness with API retrieval, documentation responses, isolated sandbox execution, and static checking, then adds governed cross-task self-evolution. Beyond solving individual tasks, ZhuLong-SE distills past execution traces into a three-tier memory store governed by ground-truth anchoring, disconfirmation filtering, held-out rollback, and anti-leakage retrieval. On the 158-task EDA-Eval-PyAether benchmark, the full task-level harness, with self-evolution disabled, achieves 92.4% pass@1 and outperforms ZhuLong on all five tested LLM backbones. On a harder instance-disjoint test set, self-evolution from the bare configuration surpasses a human-crafted-experience baseline by 2.5 percentage points (80.0% vs. 77.5% pass@1).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ZhuLong-SE，一个面向 EDA 脚本编写的执行反馈式 LLM 智能体，在任务级框架（API 检索、文档响应、隔离沙箱执行、静态检查）之上加入跨任务自演化，把历史执行轨迹蒸馏为受真值锚定、反证过滤、留出回滚和防泄漏检索约束的三层记忆库，并在 EDA-Eval-PyAether 基准上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 不含视觉或多模态内容，但其「轨迹→记忆」的筛选与回滚机制（真值锚定、反证过滤、held-out 回滚）可供核查是否用于 LVR 中轨迹训练监督与贡献分配、抑制错误 latent 经验累积。
